mentions.name: NoxEngine
mentions.description: A diffusion inference engine for image and video generation that offers a Python API as an alternative to node editors like ComfyUI. After an initial Python/PyTorch version proved too slow, the inference was rewritten in C++/CUDA to reach near-hardware performance, with planned high-resolution benchmarks (1536² for images, 1344x768 for video) to show how it scales.
mentions.problem: The author disliked node editors like ComfyUI and wanted a decent Python API to control diffusion inference; the first Python/PyTorch implementation was too slow.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a diffusion inference engine. I dislike node editors like ComfyUI and wanted a decent python API to control it.
